FN UKPCXDX-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 61
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, & Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/05/2025
Senate Bill 61 as introduced would allow the Alabama Board of Examiners in Psychology to
join the School Psychologist Interstate Licensure Compact. The provisions of this bill: (1) would
increase the financial obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount dependent on the
amount of the annual assessment fee levied by the School Psychologist Interstate Licensure
Compact Commission on each member state to cover the costs of its operations, activities, staff,
and annual budget as authorized in the compact; (2) could decrease the amount of license fees
currently collected from licensed school psychologists with out-of-state residences who decide
to become licensed in their home state and practice in Alabama under the compact privilege by
an undetermined amount annually; and (3) would increase receipts to the Board from fees
imposed for the multistate license by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of
licenses issued and the fee amounts set by the Board.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Board to submit
information to the commission's licensure database as provided for by the provisions of this bill.
